name: Feral Strength adds 50% Agility and Strength attack power in Eternal Curse (#785)
contract: Feral Strength 704661 has both effects over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 1073741824, 0) = word 1 bit 30 = Eternal Curse Hidden 804320 and Vampiric Fang 572373. Effect 0 is aura 107 with MiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 -> effect index 1) and BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50; 804320's effect 1 is aura 268 MOD_ATTACK_POWER_OF_STAT_PERCENT with MiscValue 1 (STAT_AGILITY) and value 0, so it becomes 50. Effect 1 is aura 107 with MiscValue 23 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 -> effect index 2), +50; 804320's effect 2 is the same aura with MiscValue 0 (STAT_STRENGTH) and value 0, so it becomes 50. 572373 has only an effect 0, so neither operation can reach it. 804320 is cast whenever Eternal Curse 800157 is applied (AscensionBloodmageTalents.cpp). Tooltip: "While in Eternal Curse, you now gain $s1% more attack power from Agility and Strength." Regression guard for native behaviour.

steps.label: Eternal Curse Hidden grants no Agility attack power before the talent
Eternal Curse Hidden grants no Strength attack power before the talent
Feral Strength sets the Agility conversion to 50%
Feral Strength sets the Strength conversion to 50%
Feral Strength does not touch Bloodbolt
